welcome.title: Close-up hands
welcome.text: Windows will appear in front of you. Do what each one asks, as you would on a real one: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Close-up hands
sections.intro: Windows very close to you, about a forearm's length from your eyes. Poke, tap and pinch them there, with your hand near your face and low in front of your chest. Nothing happens when you do: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand: poke each lit button with your index fingertip, in and back out.|This window is close: about a forearm's length from your eyes.

switch.to: a relaxed hand, the other fingers loosely curled

prompts.text: Left hand: poke each lit button with your index fingertip.|Keep your head still and let the hand come close to your face.
A low window just in front of your chest. Poke its buttons with your right hand,|looking straight ahead, not down at it.
A window close and out to your right. Poke it with your right hand,|keeping your head facing ahead.
Right hand close to the window: tap thumb to index on the lit button, as a click.|Hold: keep them together until it goes out.
Right hand. Pinch the lit bar or corner of this close window, hold until it goes out,|then let go.

acts.say: Pinch the lit part and hold

prompts.text: Left hand. Pinch the lit bar or corner and take it to the ghost, then let go.

acts.say: Pinch the bar, take it to the ghost

prompts.text: Both hands close, index fingers pointing. Each lit button says L or R:|poke it with that hand.
Right hand. Cyan: poke it. Orange with a cross: bring the fingertip about 1 cm short of it|and stop there, without touching.
Your own pace: poke the lit button as often as you like.|Bring the hand in close to your face and back out, higher and lower.

says.poke: Your own pace: poke it as often as you like
